explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows Fresenius Kabi and Hikma propranolol hydrochloride injection short since 2023-10-31; our supply traces to Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) which received an OAI classification in 2009 and VAI inspections through 2026-07-16

sentences.text: FDA first posted the propranolol hydrochloride injection shortage on 2023-10-31 for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., and both remain Current as of the 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-14 updates.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 36 months.
Our Corvale East and Corvale General stock both carry NDC 71335236909 labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407).
FDA inspection 590126 at that FEI ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI with six observations including lack of a written stability program.
Subsequent inspections at the same FEI were classified VAI, most recently inspection 1326578 ending 2026-07-16 with classification letter 2026-10-14.
Corvale East has 7 days on hand and Corvale General has 29 days on hand; the rule-ranked transfer of 81 units from General to East would bring East to 14 days while General retains two weeks.
Alternate manufacturers A-S Medication Solutions and AMICI PHARMACEUTICALS LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.

Q-df028a.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%propranolol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%propranolol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-e6652e.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('c139587f-fdfa-4efe-a39e-452f7c39e657') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-fedbed.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%propranolol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-2b681b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%propranolol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-cd084d.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%propranolol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-cb1e99.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-911252.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f91367.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-4217d2.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%propranolol%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-7ba5bd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('590126') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-bcb85a.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('71335236909')

Q-3457a5.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%propranolol%'
